cards.title: LouisAgent.Orchestrator
cards.text: Reads a service's errors, triages each with its runbooks, asks for a fix and checks the claim.

cards.title: A runbook first
cards.text: Skills/{service}/{method}.md from the template; most changes are one.

cards.title: A tool
cards.text: Test first, a described public method, text back, arguments as a list.

cards.title: A setting
cards.text: Read once in OrchestratorOptions, named ORCHESTRATOR_*, with a test.

cards.title: Test and run it
cards.text: The tests, then one pass with --once; a run spends money on both models, so ask first.
